出生地: 英国，英格兰，伯克郡，雷丁镇
简介: Benjamin McLean Cheng is a British-Chinese actor, voiceover artist, model and Internet personality born in Reading, Berkshire of mixed heritage. He graduated from the University of Bath with a Bachelor of Science (BSc) and trained at Middleweek Newton Drama Academy from 2022 to 2023.
